proposal.summary: A flaw in io_uring's fixed buffer registration (io_sqe_buffer_register in io_uring/rsrc.c) allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer, enabling full local privilege escalation.
proposal.affected_product: Linux kernel (io_uring fixed buffer registration), versions: unknown
proposal.cwe_quote: allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer

S.quote: allows out-of-bounds access to physical memory beyond the end of the buffer

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain vulnerable kernel version details and reproduction steps or PoC, and confirm whether exploit requires any privileges; if confirmed, prepare and publish coordinated disclosure and vendor patching guidance.
